question: Should memory-lancedb autoCapture reject EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT wrappers by default, or should users opt into that behavior through a new captureFilter config surface?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the permanent fix sets a security default, adds or avoids plugin config surface, and changes what existing autoCapture users retain from external content.

options.title: Reject wrappers by default
options.body: Treat EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT as a host-owned capture boundary before trigger matching and add regression coverage for wrapped web, browser, and tool content.

options.title: Add captureFilter config
options.body: Introduce a documented operator-controlled excludeWrapped option with schema, manifest, docs, and upgrade-safe default tests.

options.title: Defer to broader provenance design
options.body: Keep this narrow issue open until memory trust/provenance work defines the canonical source-authority contract across storage and retrieval.

recommendation.title: Reject wrappers by default
recommendation.body: Treat EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT as a host-owned capture boundary before trigger matching and add regression coverage for wrapped web, browser, and tool content.

likelyOwner.reason: The previous review and current thread routing point to steipete for the security/default decision on this exact capture path.
